news.title: Tollywood Faces Financial Pressure as Streaming Platforms Cut Budgets
news.summary: The Telugu film industry is experiencing a severe setback in the digital streaming market as platforms drastically reduce their acquisition budgets. With streaming giants refusing to pay inflated prices and tying deals directly to theatrical success, producers of high-budget and mid-range films are facing major risks. This shift is expected to force filmmakers to prioritize box-office performance and tighter production budgets.
